title: No More Google Round-Trip on Every Question | vitalii.no
description:
How moving token checks out of a network call and into local math let a live AI interview survive past Google's one-hour token limit, with zero round trips.

Ghost Interviewer re-verified the user's Google ID token with a live network call to Google on every single request. That round trip sat directly in the critical path of both the AI answer and the real-time translation, so one slow response could stall translation mid-sentence, and a token that expired mid-interview would kill the session outright.

Cloudflare Workers now issue a 12-hour HMAC-SHA256 session token with the Web Crypto API after a single Google verification, then check it locally on every later request — no network call needed. The verification layer also now rejects any ID token whose audience doesn't match the app's own client ID, instead of silently accepting a token minted for a different app. The system prompt sent to the AI can also be marked as a cache breakpoint, so it's reused across a session instead of resent on every question.

Interview sessions now run a full 12 hours without a single authentication round trip.
